mentions.name: 3D portal mill voxel simulator
mentions.description: A simulator for a 3D portal mill in which a virtual toolbit cuts a shape out of a three-dimensional array of voxels, displayed with a very simple engine built with PyGame. It was used for debugging runs and trials of machining designs instead of cutting real wood, saving time and material.
mentions.problem: Testing milling designs on real wood got expensive fast, so designs were debugged and trialed in simulation instead.
mentions.source_excerpt: I built something a little bit like this for a simulator of a 3D portal mill. Trying it on real wood got expensive fast so for debugging runs and trials of designs I would run a simulation where the toolbit would hack out the shape out of a three dimensional array of voxels. This was then displayed using a very simple engine built with PyGame.
